subject.title: fix(feishu): pace outbound sends per target

question: Should the Feishu plugin adopt this permanent default-off, process-local `sendRateLimit.minIntervalMs` contract with its current message-send scope?
rationale: The implementation matches Feishu's same-recipient quota, but adding a permanent configuration surface and accepting process-local and send-surface limitations requires Feishu owner intent.

options.title: Accept with proof and scope docs
options.body: Approve the setting after documenting process-local and covered-send semantics, resolving conflicts, and adding real configured-runtime proof.

options.title: Accept a narrower message contract
options.body: Explicitly promise pacing only for Feishu message create and reply paths and track other outbound surfaces separately if needed.

options.title: Defer to shared pacing design
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want distributed or cross-channel pacing rather than a Feishu-specific process-local option.

recommendation.title: Accept with proof and scope docs
recommendation.body: Approve the setting after documenting process-local and covered-send semantics, resolving conflicts, and adding real configured-runtime proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The plugin manifest explicitly identifies this handle as the Feishu community maintenance owner.
